description: AppForge dynamic template: Vite+React frontend, Fastify+SQLite backend. One command per operation.
name: @appforge/template-dynamic-react-node

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.migrate: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix backend run migrate
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
